16. In addition to the standard time limit condition (1), I have imposed a condition
requiring the development to be carried out in accordance with the approved plans
and documents (2) in the interests of certainty. To promote sustainable travel, I have
included a condition (3) requiring the provision of cycle storage.
17. It would not be reasonable or necessary to impose a condition requiring the
submission of a further HMO management plan (MP). This is because the
proposed occupation of No 54 would be limited to six persons, the submitted MP
broadly addresses the matters set out in the SPD, and many of these
considerations would in any event be controlled through HMO licensing
requirements. A separate condition to secure access to communal areas for all
occupants would similarly be unnecessary. Moreover, it is not necessary to impose
a condition limiting the number of residents to six, as this is already defined by the
description of development, and any additional residents would require planning
permission.
description: Change of use from single dwelling house into a small HMO for up to 6 people with associated waste/refuse cycle store and car parking (summary)
